summary: 原生账户抽象第一次分组会议召开。derekchiang 提交 EIP-8141 的 guarantor 草案：即使发送者验证失败，guarantor 也会为交易付费，内存池节点因此无需先验证发送者；他此前把交易类型混入签名哈希的修改合并。RogerPodacter 让 EIP-8182 改用 ML-KEM-768 传递私密票据，当天提交并合并。lightclient 称 EIP-7702 月活正接近 200 万。

items.title: EIP-8141：支持 guarantor
items.note: （derekchiang）提交，作为征求早期反馈的草案：引入 guarantor 这一付费方，即使发送者验证失败也为交易付费；只要交易有 guarantor，内存池节点就无需检查发送者验证能否通过。
items.note_en: (derekchiang), submitted as a draft for early feedback: a guarantor is a payer that pays for the transaction even if sender validation fails, so as long as a transaction has a guarantor, mempool nodes need not check whether sender validation passes.

summary_en: The first native account abstraction breakout took place. derekchiang submitted a guarantor draft for EIP-8141: a guarantor pays for the transaction even if sender validation fails, so mempool nodes do not need to check sender validation first; his change mixing the transaction type into the sighash was merged. RogerPodacter moved EIP-8182 to ML-KEM-768 for private note delivery, submitted and merged the same day. lightclient said EIP-7702 is heading toward 2 million MAU.
